From our unit on Thirukkanur Road

  • The farmer

    When the motor starts, the water has to reach the last row.

    Our pressure pipes are printed with their pressure rating and class, so you can choose the right one for your motor and your field before the season starts.

  • The family building a home

    Once the walls are tiled, nobody wants to think about the pipes again.

    Plumbing lines get sealed into walls and floors for years. We make ours for exactly that kind of forgetting: clearly marked, consistently sized and easy for your plumber to trust.

  • The electrician

    Every wire behind the switchboard needs a safe path.

    Our conduit pipes and junction boxes keep wiring protected inside walls and slabs, for the family who switches on the lights every evening without a second thought.

What we make

PVC pressure pipes for water, conduit pipes for wiring, and the fittings that join them.

PVC pressure pipes

For irrigation lines, water supply and plumbing. Every length is printed with its size, pressure rating and class, so you know exactly what you're buying.

Size
Pressure class
agarwalPVC PRESSURE PIPE 75mm 4kgf / cm² CLASS 2ISO 9001:2015 Company

You'll find this line printed along a 75 mm Class 2 pipe.

A higher class has a thicker wall and takes more pressure. Not sure which you need? Tell us your motor size and how far the water has to travel, and we'll help you choose.

Why water matters to us

Written centuries ago, it is still the simplest truth we know. Our part is making sure the water gets there.

They handle every order the way they would want their own to be handled.
